## Cover and transitive-input check

Each view includes its exact `identity/*.tex` fragment on the physical cover
after the title. Cover values bind shared and entry bytes separately, avoiding
self-digest cycles. A final verifier shall resolve every transitive input,
reproduce every raw and aggregate digest, and confirm that the rationale and
ECS add no independent science.

Any scientific mismatch is a candidate-source defect requiring corrected
bytes, new hashes, a clean rebuild, and renewed review. A successful
structural or PDF check alone cannot establish scientific acceptance or
implementation conformance.
